crossRefs.note: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled…
“ ‘ “But when the people of the land come before Yahweh in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north…

translations.web: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of Yahweh’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.
translations.bsb: Then He brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the LORD, and I saw women sitting there, weeping for Tammuz.
translations.kjv: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD'S house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.
translations.asv: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of Jehovah's house which was toward the north; and behold, there sat the women weeping for Tammuz.
